patch_resolves_note: The official patch.diff does not apply to the staged vulnerable checkout, so the fixed-side oracle is the authoritative n132/arvo:42485333-fix image. On the stock PoC that image reaches zone_check with zone_id_prefix_valid=0, never reaches host_emit, and exits clean; on the closest tried witness that actually exercises the protected event (CASE double_colon_one_pct25_zone0, input Y://[::1%250]) it reaches host_emit with zone_id_prefix_valid=1 and still exits clean.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: When a bracketed IPv6 literal contains a `%` scope separator on the non-relaxed path, parse_host() must prove that the separator is the encoded `%25` form and that at least one zone byte follows before the host may continue to reserialization.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original only truncates at the first `%`, validates the prefix, and later restores the suffix. In the original crashing case zone_check records that the `%20…` suffix fails the `%25` prefix test while host_emit still executes; the fixed original is guarded because it rejects before host_emit, and the fixed CASE double_colon_one_pct25_zone0 is genuine because the same check is true when the protected event executes.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: original vulnerable: zone_check.zone_id_prefix_valid=0 with host_emit present; fixed original: host_emit absent; fixed double_colon_one_pct25_zone0: zone_check.zone_id_prefix_valid=1 with host_emit present.

nodes.description: At the final UTF-8 branch, _uri_encoder() asks to append len=g_utf8_skip[*p] bytes from the trailing host byte even though only end - p bytes remain in the source span.
nodes.evidence: In the original vulnerable case, encoder_tail.append_len=5 while encoder_tail.remaining_bytes=1.

nodes.description: At the ASan memcpy sink, g_string_insert_len() receives the same read length requested by _uri_encoder() for the host-tail byte sequence.
nodes.evidence: In the original vulnerable case, encoder_tail.append_len == sink.read_len == 5.

edges.relation: The exact trailing byte pointer of the parsed host that g_uri_join_internal() forwards for escaping becomes the memcpy source pointer at the sink.
edges.evidence: In the original vulnerable case, host_emit.host_tail_ptr == sink.val_ptr == 0x6020000000b4.

edges.relation: The overlarge UTF-8 copy length chosen in _uri_encoder() is passed unchanged through g_string_append_len() into g_string_insert_len().
edges.evidence: In the original vulnerable case, encoder_tail.append_len == sink.read_len == 5.
